# valtag

> Ask-first credential gate for AI agents: an agent requests access, a human
> approves, valtag mints a short-lived derived key (valtag_dk_…), the real
> upstream credential never leaves the vault, every action lands in a
> hash-chained audit trail. Self-hosted: Postgres is the only stateful piece.

- API: `/api/v1` — Bearer user JWT or agent token
- Health: `GET /health`; discovery: `/.well-known/valtag.json`
- Gateway: `POST /gateway/v1/authorize` with `Authorization: Bearer valtag_dk_…`
  (lease-bound key) — 200 returns the real upstream credential as response
  headers (authorization + x-valtag-*); 401/403 = fail-closed
- Errors: RFC 9457 Problem Details — send `Accept: application/problem+json`;
  every error carries a stable `code`; rate-limited responses carry
  `RateLimit-Limit` + `Retry-After`
- MCP: `valtag-mcp-server` (stdio) — the ask-first flow as tools
  (request_secret_access → check_approval_status → get_credential →
  revoke_credential); install: `valtag mcp install --ide claude`
- CLI: `valtag request create|status|get … --json` — machine-readable output
- Docs: [AX contract](docs/ax.md) · [deployment](docs/deployment-guide.md) ·
  [key rotation](docs/key-rotation.md) ·
  [Higress integration demo](demo/higress/README.md)
- Source: https://github.com/ldphuong-vn/valtag
